**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Emit bytes matching the committed verification artifact**

Fresh reproduction on exact commit `afa303d` still shows that running this verifier changes `independent_leakage_verification.json` from the manifest's `2483901e...` to `d75bbca8...`, after which `verify_manifest.py` reports `MISMATCH`. The committed blob remains CRLF while `write_text` emits LF on Linux, and `* -text` prevents Git from normalizing it, so the claimed canonical-LF remediation does not work; commit the generator's LF bytes or write an explicitly canonical byte sequence and regenerate the manifest.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Compare the independently recomputed top-level verdict**

Fresh evidence in exact commit `afa303d` is that the new verifier reads only `synthetic_demo` and never reads the committed top-level `verdict` or `pre_registered_checks`. It therefore returns `INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_MATCH` even if `bio001_r1_results.json` declares the opposite verdict or the production verdict logic is wrong, despite `round.json` claiming full main-verdict reproduction; recompute the expected verdict and compare it explicitly with the committed one.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove functional siblings from the CLEAN training set**

Both `run_same_T` calls build the identical training set containing every non-held gene, so CLEAN still has all functional-sibling rows; `siblings=False` merely ignores the computed group means and substitutes a constant predictor. Consequently the reported 0.8776 gap measures a group-aware estimator versus a global-mean estimator, not inflation caused by sibling exposure under different splits, and cannot support `LEAKAGE_DEMO_PASS`. Filter sibling rows from CLEAN training while retaining the same test rows, or describe this as a model ablation rather than leakage.
